_note: Week 1 candidate shortlist for the reference laptop (Windows, 8-16 GB RAM, CPU only). Sizes are approximate unless size_bytes is given. Files with a sha256 were downloaded and checked against the Hugging Face checksum on 2026-09-28; fetch_models.ps1 refuses a download that does not match. Verify links and licences of the others before first download.

llama_cpp._note: Pinned llama.cpp build used for the Week 1/2 runs. fetch_runtime.ps1 downloads this tag by default; pass -Tag latest to try a newer build.

candidates.name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
candidates.why: Primary pick: strongest instruction following / grounding in the 4B class, permissive licence, long context, non-thinking variant (no <think> blocks to strip).

candidates.name: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
candidates.why: Well-known baseline with broad tooling support; good fallback if Qwen licence or quality is a concern.

candidates.name: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
candidates.why: MIT licence, long context, strong on reading-comprehension style tasks.

candidates.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
candidates.why: Low-spec fallback for 8 GB machines under memory pressure; fast download for smoke tests.

candidates.name: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct
candidates.why: Very fast, permissive; context is short (8k) so only for small documents.
